hero.subheadline: Live jazz bands compete for €10,000 in Bucharest
hero.valueProposition: Jazz bands and vocalists up to age 45 compete live in Bucharest for €10,000 in cash and concert engagements at the 21st Bucharest International Jazz Competition.

content.whyJoin:
The Bucharest International Jazz Competition is one of the most appreciated jazz events among specialists and the public, ranked among the first three European jazz competitions. Its 21st edition takes place July 2-10, 2027 as part of the International Festival EUROPAfest, bringing together concerts, jam sessions, workshops, and jazz master-classes in Bucharest.

Winners share a prize pool of €10,000 in cash and concert engagements, with the Grand Prize Winner receiving €1,500. Finalists get free accommodation through the competition's hotel system, and semifinalists receive special accommodation pricing. Beyond the prize money, the competition acts as a promoter for jazz musicians and bands around the world, contributing to international recognition and career exposure.

Entries are judged by a jury of artists and teachers from the international jazz world. The event has a reputation for memorable concerts and a strong audience, and it provides a direct route to concert engagements beyond the competition itself.
content.whoShouldApply:
This competition is for jazz instrumentalists, bands, and vocalists of all nationalities, up to age 45 (applicants must be born after July 1, 1982, though the band leader may be older). It suits serious jazz performers who are ready to compete live in front of a jury and international audience, and who can travel to Bucharest for the July event.

It is suited to bands and vocalists who can submit audio recordings, photos, and supporting documents for a judged selection process, and who can perform in front of a live audience during the competition days. It is less suited to performers older than 45 (except as band leaders) or those who cannot commit to the live event in Bucharest.

faq.question: What is the registration fee?
faq.answer: The registration fee is €140 per application or band, paid by bank transfer to the competition's account. The fee is non-refundable, except it is refunded to competitors who have complete application documents and are not accepted into the semifinal based on recordings.

faq.question: Who is eligible to apply?
faq.answer: The competition is open to jazz instrumentalists, bands, and vocalists of all nationalities. Applicants must be born after July 1, 1982, so up to age 45, though the band leader may be older than 45.

faq.question: What are the prizes?
faq.answer: The total amount of prizes is €10,000 in cash and concert engagements, including €1,500 for the Grand Prize Winner, €500 for Best Band, €500 for Best Vocalist, and €250 for Best Jam Session.

faq.question: When is the registration deadline?
faq.answer: The registration deadline is March 1, 2027 at 23:59. Applications are submitted with digital documents via transfernow.net to the competition emails.

faq.question: When and where does the competition take place?
faq.answer: The 21st Bucharest International Jazz Competition takes place July 2-10, 2027 in Bucharest, Romania, as part of the International Festival EUROPAfest, combining concerts, jam sessions, workshops, and jazz master-classes.

faq.question: What documents are required for application?
faq.answer: Applicants submit the application form, audio recordings in mp3 or mp4 format, two group photos, a copy of the bank payment confirmation, a short group presentation, copies of passport or ID for each member, and a technical rider.

submissionGuide.detail: Transfer €140 by bank transfer to the competition account, with the subject line Registration fee BIJC followed by your band's name. Drafts and bank cheques are not accepted.

Complete the application form, record audio in mp3 or mp4 format, take two color group photos in landscape format of at least 1MB, write a group presentation of up to 10 lines, prepare copies of ID for each member, and list your technical rider.

Put all documents in a folder named after your band, compress it as a zip file, and send it via transfernow.net to office@jmevents.ro and jmevents.ro@gmail.com, mentioning Application and your band's name.
The jury reviews applications and selects semifinalists from the recordings. If your documents are complete but you are not accepted into the semifinal, your registration fee is refunded.
Semifinalists and finalists perform live in Bucharest from July 2-10, 2027, with finalists receiving free accommodation through the competition's hotel system and concert engagement opportunities.
